title: sieve-native: cross-validation test suite against sieve-rs
description:
Test suite that cross-validates the native implementation against sieve-rs as an independent oracle.

What: crates/sieve-native/tests/cross_validate.rs + Cargo.toml [dev-dependencies]

Oracle: usenet-ipfs-sieve (which wraps sieve-rs) is added as a dev-dependency. Tests run identical scripts through both implementations and assert the output Vec<SieveAction> matches. sieve-rs is NEVER a production dependency — only [dev-dependencies].

Test cases (each runs through both impls, asserts equal):
1. implicit_keep: empty script → [Keep]
2. explicit_keep: 'keep;' → [Keep]
3. fileinto_inbox: 'require ["fileinto"]; fileinto "INBOX";' → [FileInto("INBOX")]
4. fileinto_newsgroup: 'require ["fileinto"]; fileinto "newsgroup:comp.lang.rust";' → [FileInto("newsgroup:comp.lang.rust")]
5. reject_spam: 'reject "no spam";' → [Reject("no spam")]
6. discard: 'discard;' → [Discard]
7. header_contains_match: script using header :contains; message with matching header → [FileInto(...)]; non-matching → [Keep]
8. header_is_case_insensitive: same script, header value in different case → same result
9. address_localpart: script tests :localpart; envelope from various addresses → correct routing
10. size_over: message over limit → discard; under limit → keep
11. allof_anyof: combined conditions
12. variables_set_fileinto: require variables; set "list" "comp.lang.rust"; fileinto "newsgroup:${list}"; → [FileInto("newsgroup:comp.lang.rust")]
13. RFC 5228 Appendix A example scripts (copy verbatim from spec text)

Build gate: if cross-validation diverges, the test prints both outputs and fails with a clear diff.
